text:
morgan: Heads-up — ran a quick walkthrough of the policy editor simulation and noticed a few clarity and a11y rough edges. Sharing screenshots in a sec but wanted to capture thoughts first. :eyes:

samir: cool — can you list the top 3 things you hit? helps me prioritize fixes for the sprint.

morgan: 1) the ordering affordance is subtle — users don't realise you can change precedence inline. 2) validation tones are too technical (stack traces-esque). 3) the live-sim output is noisy; we should show aggregated matches + an obvious 'conflicts' bucket.

kelly: agree on validation copy — current error: "Rule X failed to compile: mismatched selector". Suggestion: "This rule conflicts with an earlier rule. Click to see the conflicting conditions." (short + actionable).

rachel: for the ordering affordance — can we add a small keyboard affordance hint? e.g. "Press Space to lift rule, then Arrow keys to move". Also need to ensure focus is visible when dragging via keyboard (:accessibility).

samir: keyboard move makes sense. Implementation note: we'd toggle a CSS class for keyboard-reorder-mode and trap focus inside the rule item. Also need to preserve announce events for screenreaders (aria-live) when item position changes.

morgan: exactly. For aria-live, use polite updates for counts and an assertive region only for critical errors. Avoid shouting number-of-matches on every sim tick.

daniel: regarding the sim output UX — propose a condensed header: "Matches: 24 | Conflicts: 3 | Fallbacks: 1" with a chevron to expand detailed logs. That prevents overflow and is easy to scan.

kelly: love that. For the expanded logs, we should group by traffic sample and show a small bar sparkline for relative volume. Example line: "sample: signup-flow — matched rule: send-welcome (12)". Keep each line one-liner, avoid blocky JSON.

designbot: Automated sim snapshot generated by sandbox-run @1769999999:
```
summary: {matched: 12, conflicts: 3, fallback: 2}
top_matches: [send-welcome:7, block-spam:3, rate-limit:2]
```

rachel: small contrast nit — the chevron and hint text are at 3:1 with background in the current figma. Need 4.5:1 for body text minimum. I'll drop an annotation.

morgan: copy change + contrast work sounds like a plan. Also we should add a microcopy line under validation errors: "Pro tip: try moving the rule up to test precedence." Short, encouraging.

samir: I'll pick up keyboard reorder + aria-live changes. daniel, you okay to wire the sim header collapse? kelly can you draft the exact microcopy strings and a brief a11y acceptance checklist?

daniel: yep, I'll do the header collapse and the aggregated counts. Will add a small animation for the chevron state.

kelly: on it — will post copy PR by EOD with variants for tone (friendly / formal) and include screenreader-only versions.

morgan: amazing — thanks team. Follow-up: let's add one UX test case for "conflicting rules visible in collapsed state" so PMs can validate. I'll create the ticket. :memo:
